plan.objective: Identify concrete taxonomy defects in cache.py with exact line evidence, focused on the cache key construction and related correctness issues.

steps.description: Read cache.py in full to capture exact line numbers and the price() caching logic.
steps.success_criterion: Numbered source of cache.py including the cache lookup and assignment lines is captured.

steps.description: Analyze the cache lookup/store lines from cache_source_lines to determine whether the key omits the currency parameter, causing cross-currency cache collisions.
steps.success_criterion: A documented incorrect_cache_key finding citing the exact lines of the lookup and store, or an explicit determination that the key includes currency.

steps.description: Analyze the fetch call and cache storage path in cache_source_lines for missing_await on a coroutine result and for swallowed_exception or unchecked_status around fetch.
steps.success_criterion: Each of missing_await, swallowed_exception, unchecked_status is marked present with line evidence or ruled out.

steps.description: Analyze the module-level mutable cache dict and the check-then-set sequence in cache_source_lines for mutable_default, race_condition, and resource_leak exposure.
steps.success_criterion: Each of mutable_default, race_condition, resource_leak is marked present with line evidence or ruled out.

steps.description: Run the linter on cache.py to corroborate or refute the suspected defects with tool-reported line evidence.
steps.success_criterion: Linter completes and its diagnostics are mapped to the taxonomy categories under consideration.

steps.description: Merge cache_key_finding, fetch_handling_finding, shared_state_finding, and linter_report into a final deduplicated defect list using only frozen taxonomy categories with exact line citations.
steps.success_criterion: Every reported defect has one taxonomy category and at least one exact line reference; unsupported or style items are excluded.

plan.completion_criterion: final_defect_report lists all confirmed taxonomy defects in cache.py with exact line evidence and no speculative or style items.

defects.rationale: Cache key uses only product_id while the fetched value depends on currency, so a lookup in one currency returns prices cached for another.
Module-level mutable `cache` dict is checked and written non-atomically across lines 4-7; concurrent callers can perform duplicate fetches and overwrite entries.
